summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the publication of a multinational real-world evidence study in the Journal of the American Society of Nephrology. The study associates high-volume hemodiafiltration with a 28% lower relative risk of all-cause mortality versus conventional high-flux hemodialysis, based on nearly 20,000 patients across eight European countries. This is a routine scientific/clinical announcement, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate event is involved. What to watch: none; this is informational only and does not constitute a deal or special-situation event.
